caveats: Playbooks contain Jinja2 control flow; the static command list is parsed without rendering, so a rendered run may repeat or skip commands. Counts here are of static annotated commands.
Unlabelled commands are excluded from the corpus and counted separately. Absence of a label is absence of annotation, not evidence that no technique occurred.
Technique order inside a command is discarded by design.
